classification: library header/action content layout under valid public default widths; not an unsupported fixture configuration
sourceFinding: DataGrid passes public flexible-column minWidth120 and React Aria applies resolved numeric header widths. Narrow captures already show horizontal overflow; the source does not demonstrate the shared min/max/flex solver shrinking below minima.

The columnHeader flex row combines the sorting caption, resizer and width-popover button in that same 120px allocation. Resize controls consume caption space, creating character towers even though the column minimum is passed.
Selection utility width150/min100 consumes much of a narrow viewport but is not the data-column allocation mechanism; this bounded fix preserves it.
Action container is an unconstrained flex row; explicitly wrapping and bounding children to the cell prevents long RTL action content extending outside its allocated utility column.
fix: Wrap caption in columnLabel with full header width. Place caption above existing resize controls in a two-column grid.
Constrain action children to cell inline size and allow wrapping.
Do not change fixture labels/columns, public defaults, shared sizing core, utility allocations, resize callbacks, min/max or fill-column policy.
regression: Existing eight visual cases additionally assert data-column minimum120, ordinary-word caption width, bounded header height, actual narrow horizontal overflow and action label/button/cell bounds in both directions. No extra screenshot cases or weakened entry/screenshot assertions.
validation: admission-03 records affected units, one fresh library/host build, browser types and recapture; final native result pending at finding creation.
